create_cooling_rate_polynomial_fit: create a polynomial fit to evaluate impurity radiative cooling rates in non-coronal equilibrium
run_evaluate_polynomial_fit: run evaluate_polynomial_fit to compute cooling rate from electron temperature and ne_tau_fraction using Mavrin coefficients
review_COEFFS: review the COEFFS mapping containing polynomial fit coefficients for He, Li, Be, C, N, O, Ne, and Ar impurities
review_TEMPERATURE_INTERVALS: review TEMPERATURE_INTERVALS mapping that defines temperature boundaries in keV for selecting coefficient columns per impurity
review_MIN_MAX_TEMPERATURES: review MIN_TEMPERATURES and MAX_TEMPERATURES mappings that define valid temperature ranges per impurity species
